_doctrine: 13-phase Wall Street cycle. Phase is JORDAN'S call (editorial). Until he calls it, phase='Awaiting Jordan's call' and phase_source='awaiting'. Score + trend are facts and always present; phase_suggestion is the auto/brain advisory. next_move is the FORWARD prediction (brain consensus) — where the phase goes next; current phase stays the anchor.

next_move.reasoning: The score sits in Denial (32-38) with diverging factors creating a coil — the statistically honest default is HOLD until either ETF flow resumption (UP) or funding/momentum breakdown (DOWN) provides a visible breaker.
next_move.brains_agree: No — analyst calls HOLD citing no breaker and exhaustion divergences; narrative implies UP via accumulation analogy; judge sides with analyst on direction given higher trust weight and stronger evidence.
next_move.confirmed_if: ETF flows recover above 30 AND stablecoin_growth turns positive — risk-on re-engagement confirming Disbelief leg up toward Hope.
next_move.invalidated_if: ETF flows remain below 10 AND funding drops below 0.002% with btc_momentum_30d breaking below 40 — confirms Denial rolling down into Anxiety/Panic, not up.
